Concept 04 / Alternative direction / Multi-brand campaign

GO DUTCH.

A familiar stereotype. A new, real-world meaning.

FIVE BRANDS / HEMA · PostNL · Tikkie · Coolblue · ASMLFORMAT / Object-led photographic still lifes

The idea.

“Going Dutch” is a familiar expression for splitting the bill. We take that stereotypical phrase and fill it with a new, realistic meaning: the ingenuity, practicality and everyday usefulness of Dutch brands.

Five distinct still lifes turn let’s GO DUTCH. into an invitation to experience what these brands actually do—from daily essentials and deliveries to payments, technology and advanced engineering.

This is an alternative execution of WE ARE DUTCHEST., retaining its five-brand premise while giving the expression a fresh role as the campaign’s call to action.
